description: This file contains API functions for the Education module in an ERP system, handling student enrollment, attendance, fee management, assessments, and related operations.

methods.name: get_course
methods.description: Returns a list of courses for a given program.

methods.name: enroll_student
methods.description: Creates a Student record and returns a Program Enrollment.

methods.name: check_attendance_records_exist
methods.description: Checks if attendance records exist for a specific course schedule or student group on a given date.

methods.name: mark_attendance
methods.description: Marks attendance for students as present or absent for a specific date and schedule.

methods.name: make_attendance_records
methods.description: Creates or updates an individual attendance record.

methods.name: get_student_guardians
methods.description: Retrieves guardians of a student.

methods.name: get_student_group_students
methods.description: Retrieves students in a student group, optionally including inactive students.

methods.name: get_fee_structure
methods.description: Retrieves fee structure for a program and optional academic term.

methods.name: get_fee_components
methods.description: Retrieves fee components for a given fee structure.

methods.name: get_fee_schedule
methods.description: Retrieves fee schedule for a program and optional student category.

methods.name: collect_fees
methods.description: Updates paid and outstanding amounts for a fee record.

methods.name: get_course_schedule_events
methods.description: Fetches course schedule events for calendar display within a date range.

methods.name: get_assessment_criteria
methods.description: Retrieves assessment criteria and weightage for a course.

methods.name: get_assessment_students
methods.description: Retrieves students and their assessment results for a given assessment plan and student group.

methods.name: get_assessment_details
methods.description: Retrieves assessment criteria and maximum scores for an assessment plan.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Fetches submitted assessment result for a student and assessment plan.

methods.name: get_grade
methods.description: Determines grade based on grading scale and percentage score.

methods.name: mark_assessment_result
methods.description: Records or updates assessment results for a student.

methods.name: submit_assessment_results
methods.description: Submits assessment results for all students in a group.

methods.name: get_assessment_result_doc
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an assessment result document for a student.

methods.name: update_email_group
methods.description: Creates or updates an email group and subscribes guardians.

methods.name: get_current_enrollment
methods.description: Retrieves current program enrollment for a student in the current or specified academic year.
